title: Dialectica Named to FT1000 Europe's Fastest-Growing Companies for Sixth Consecutive Year
summary: Dialectica was recognized in the FT 1000: Europe's Fastest-Growing Companies 2026, the ranking published by the Financial Times with Statista based on revenue growth between 2021 and 2024, for the sixth consecutive year. In the announcement the company said it has invested over $30 million in AI and technology during the last three years and has a tech team of more than 100 engineers and data scientists.
whyItMatters: Six straight FT1000 appearances indicate Dialectica has sustained high growth well past the start-up phase, while its stated technology investment has risen from the $25M+ previously cited to over $30M.
